featured_reviews.name: Aleena George
featured_reviews.review_text:
Writing this after staying there for a year. The society is super strict with tenants (mostly students). They won’t even let family members in after 10:30 PM. If you have guests over, the guards come at exactly 10:30 to throw them out, and the way they ask us to make them leave is extremely rude and mannerless. I believe this attitude is mainly towards students.

If you’re a family planning to stay there, just know that the flats are pretty small and overpriced.

The day we moved here, they gave us an extremely dirty flat after claiming they had done a “deep cleaning” a week earlier. I personally had to help the maid they sent after seeing how much she was struggling. The owner also kept all their extra stuff in our apartment, and even after repeatedly asking them to shift it, they never did. We were the ones who had to suffer because of it. Don’t fall for their extra sweet assurances, nobody shows up when you actually need them.

I should also add that the flats stay very cool, and the surroundings are quite pretty, especially with all the trees and benches around.

Overall, it was a very bad experience, and the location only adds to the suffering. It takes at least 10 -15 minutes just to get out of Juhu Circle because of the traffic. However, I do have to mention that there’s a bus station right in front of the society, which is useful if you travel by bus often. Otherwise, you won’t even get autos easily.

So, if you’re a student, I’d advise you to keep searching and find a better place.
